claims.claim_atom: In the anti-CD8 Hepa1-6 experiment, the Veh-group liver weight (Fig. S10a, B4:B11) minus the paired tumour weight (Fig. 4m, B4:B11) equals exactly 1.10 for every one of the 8 mice. This fixed within-group difference is a deterministic artifact of how tumour weight was computed: reported tumour weight = whole-liver weight of the tumour-bearing mouse - the average liver weight of the corresponding no-tumour treatment group, so liver - tumour = that group's average no-tumour liver weight (a constant). The corresponding author explained this on PubPeer; it is a legitimate calculation rule, not fabricated digit patterning.
claims._adjudication: 合法(consistent, 已算术验证): Veh组8只liver-tumor全=1.10; Aldo组9只全=0.908; Aldo+CD8组8只全=0.930。作者解释 tumor weight=带瘤肝重-对应处理组无瘤平均肝重(肝需保完整瘤-旁瘤边界做H&E/IHC不能剥离称重), 组内减同一平均→固定差值=组无瘤平均肝重常数。合法计算规则(合作方常规做法)非造假。AI不应仅凭组内固定差值判异常。

claims.claim_atom: The same exact fixed difference recurs in every treatment group (Aldo: liver-tumour = 0.908 for all 9 mice, column C; Aldo+anti-CD8: 0.930), showing the reported tumour weights are DERIVED by subtracting a single per-group constant rather than being independent per-animal tumour measurements. This derivation was not stated in the paper's Methods or figure legends; the corresponding author acknowledged the paper did not describe the procedure transparently. The implicit presentation of these as directly measured tumour weights is therefore inconsistent with their calculated provenance (author-acknowledged documentation/derivation gap).
claims._adjudication: 作者已承认的文档/派生gap(inconsistent非high): 三组各自恒定差值证tumor weight是'肝重-组常数'派生非独立测量; 论文正文/图例未说明(作者致歉承认没更透明说明)。'这些是直接测量tumor weight'的隐含呈现与派生来源不一致。非造假但provenance未闭合。

claims.claim_atom: Whether the underlying whole-liver weights (Fig. S10a) and the no-tumour group-average subtrahends are themselves accurate cannot be verified from the deposited Source Data: the reviewer requested the original per-animal weighing records, and neither the raw per-animal liver weights of the no-tumour control cohorts nor their averaging can be independently checked from the published spreadsheets. The Aldo+anti-CD8 group shows the fixed 0.930 difference (column D) but the raw records behind it are not provided.
claims._adjudication: 待定(insufficient): 派生算法算术可从公开值复现(liver-tumor=组常数), 但底层带瘤整肝重与无瘤对照组平均肝重的真实性无法仅凭已公开Source Data核验; 评论者索要的原始逐只称重记录未提供。
